latest.title: What If Trees Could Talk to Us? The Hidden Conversations of Nature and How AI Could Help Us Hear Them
latest.description: What if trees could communicate with humans and share the secrets of our planet? 🌳 Trees already exchange signals through their roots, chemical substances, and interactions with their environment. With the help of Artificial Intelligence (AI), we may one day understand these signals and discover what forests need to survive. This article explores the fascinating connection between nature, science, and AI, and how technology could help us protect our planet.

latest.title: Your AI Agent Needs a “Pending” State: A Simple AWS Design
latest.description: What should an AI agent do when an API times out after an action might have succeeded? This beginner-friendly guide uses an order-cancellation example with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and DynamoDB.

latest.title: AI-DLC Workflow V2のIntentの切り方: 小さく始めて、ちょうどいい大きさを見つける
latest.description: 「1サイクル回すのに2か月かかりました...」「出てくるドキュメントが膨大で、レビューが辛いです...」「このIntent、いつ終わるんですか？」。そんな相談をよく受けます。原因の多くは、Intentの大きさにあります。ただ、最初からちょうどいい大きさを当てるのは難しいものです。小さく始めて、サイクルを回しながらチームに合うサイズの感覚を掴んでいく方法を見ていきましょう。シリーズ第32回。

latest.title: Beyond Deployment: Advanced AWS Monitoring, Observability, and Reliability Engineering
latest.description:
Deploying an application successfully is only the beginning of building a reliable cloud system.
Once an application is running in production, we need to understand whether it is healthy, how it performs under load, why errors occur, and how quickly we can recover from failures.
This is where monitoring, observability, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) become essential.
In our previous articles, we explored AWS fundamentals, Docker, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
